{"type":"flowgraph","mermaid":"flowchart TD Read["Read MicroDDL line by line"] Dispatch{"First
character?"} Table["! -> open a table stanza"] Column["@ % ~ # . $ * & ^ { -> add a column
to the current table"] Index["+ -> add a named index"] Directive["[ -> domain / include /
authorization / PICT stanza"] Blank["blank line -> close the
current stanza, reset state"] Include["Resolve [Include ...] files
recursively"] Schemas["Auto-generate inline
Meadow schemas per table"] Write["Write basic + extended + PICT JSON"] Read --> Dispatch Dispatch --> Table Dispatch --> Column Dispatch --> Index Dispatch --> Directive Dispatch --> Blank Table --> Include Column --> Include Index --> Include Directive --> Include Blank --> Include Include --> Schemas Schemas --> Write ","style":"notebook"}
